## Decision Log
Complete these fields for one meaningful product or release decision in this PR. The merged-PR workflow adds the entry to the Referral Navigator Decision Log only when all five fields below are filled. Keep the rationale grounded in what was actually decided or observed.

### Area
<!-- Required. Example: Referral timeline, AI draft assist, landing page -->

### Decision / direction
<!-- Required. State what was decided and what changed. -->

### Reason / problem
<!-- Required. Why was this direction chosen? -->

### Evidence / uncertainty
<!-- Required. What supports this decision, and what remains unverified? -->

### Validation / follow-up
<!-- Required. What should be checked next? -->

### Version / phase
<!-- Optional. If blank, the workflow uses the version in the branch name. -->
